module: Node "Get First Element of Table" (repeat_instant). Returns the first element (index 1) of a table. Input: table. Output: firstElement (any).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

_executionStarted.desc: Sets oldPos to nil (field unused afterwards).

getFirstElement.desc: Returns table[1] of the input pin table (the argument is not used).

table.desc: Ignored: the function rereads the input pin.

work.desc: Writes the first element to firstElement if the table is connected.
